title: Read Google Sheets cell values with AI from a set range
h1: ask about the values in a specific google sheets range
description: Read a chosen Google Sheets range with a bot, using calculated values or formulas. Set the exact file, tab and range, and understand its Metal access rule.
keyword: read google sheets values with ai
keywords: google sheets get cell values with ai
answer: **get the figures for your decision without digging through the workbook.** name the file, tab and cells. the bot can read displayed figures, raw calculated values or formulas from that range. dusk labels this lookup as a write, so allow read and write and limit the bot to this retrieval action.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: the numbers from the range you chose.
what:
**get the number, or find out how the sheet got it.** choose what your question needs. paste the sheet link and name the tab and cells, such as 'cost review, a1 to d12'.

- displayed values are the default, including currency and date formatting
- raw calculated values suit arithmetic
- formulas show how the sheet gets its answer

for dates, choose readable dates or raw numbers.
uses: read a quoted price table without editing its source
explain formulas in a small costing range
compare a monthly summary without bringing in the whole workbook

routine.message: every tuesday at 14:05, read a1:d12 on the cost review tab in the linked lunecrest print sheet. use raw calculated values to compare paper and binding costs. name the range beside the result here. show blanks separately from zero. never update cells or reorder rows. ask before reading beyond that range.
routine.needs: google sheets read and write, limited to get spreadsheet values
routine.output:
lunecrest print, cost review a1:d12
paper: 180
binding: 95
difference: 85
blank delivery cost excluded. no cells changed.

steps: connect sheets with **read and write**, allowing only this lookup action
paste the file link and name the tab and exact cells
ask for figures or formulas to match your question
compare one result with the sheet, then edit the schedule card if needed
watch: **copy the tab name from the sheet.** a spelling mismatch can stop the lookup.
**huge ranges can fail.** ask the bot to read a few hundred rows at a time.
**use calculated values to do the maths.** formulas show the workings; readable dates save you from puzzling over raw date numbers.
rules: **give it the lookup, keep the editing tools out.** allow this retrieval action only. reading a range needs no sorting or cell updates.

faq.q: can it show formulas instead of the displayed totals?
faq.a: **yes, ask for formulas.** ask for calculated values instead when you want to compare the resulting figures.

faq.q: why is read-only access refusing a cell lookup?
faq.a: **dusk classifies this lookup as a change.** give read and write access, then restrict it to this action. that keeps cell edits out.

steps: name one tab and a small range
ask for raw figures or formulas
compare one returned cell with the sheet

mistakes.mistake: treating an empty cost as zero
mistakes.fix: tell the bot to list blanks separately and leave them out of totals.

mistakes.mistake: doing arithmetic on displayed currency text
mistakes.fix: ask for raw calculated values first.

tip.text: include the column headings. 180 means little until you know what it pays for.
